title: Recurring food-access interruptions at small animal shelters
observed_condition: Partner reports and local observations indicate that some small shelters can experience intermittent access to appropriate food even when potential donor supply exists elsewhere.
unresolved_core: Determine whether the binding constraint is actual scarcity, matching, transport, verification, or a combination—and identify the smallest safe intervention that reduces interruptions.
knowledge_frontier: The existence and frequency of interruptions still require a frozen baseline.
The relative importance of supply shortage versus access/logistics failure remains unresolved.
Any nutrition matching must remain species- and condition-specific rather than generic.
success: Reduce verified interruption frequency against a frozen baseline without increasing food-safety incidents.
authority: Any field intervention requires explicit approval from participating shelters/operators. No autonomous allocation or dispatch.

subproblems.title: Establish the baseline
subproblems.detail: Quantify interruption frequency, duration, severity, and likely causes.

subproblems.title: Map usable surplus
subproblems.detail: Identify donors, item constraints, timing, and confidence in availability.

subproblems.title: Encode safe compatibility
subproblems.detail: Define species- and condition-aware food constraints with expert review.

subproblems.title: Test logistics matching
subproblems.detail: Evaluate whether routing and scheduling can close verified access gaps.

subproblems.title: Run a shadow pilot
subproblems.detail: Compare system recommendations with operator decisions before any consequential use.

title: Pedestrian conflict around a transit-adjacent intersection
observed_condition: Repeated near-conflict reports suggest a crossing may create avoidable pedestrian/vehicle interaction during peak flows.
unresolved_core: Establish whether the observed condition is recurrent and identify whether geometry, signal timing, visibility, or behavior is the dominant mechanism.
knowledge_frontier: No sufficiently representative observation sample yet.
success: A problem formulation that survives independent review and yields measurable pre/post safety indicators.
authority: Road or signal changes require competent transport authority approval.

subproblems.title: Collect representative observations
subproblems.detail: Sample peak/off-peak periods without storing unnecessary personal identifiers.

subproblems.title: Test competing mechanisms
subproblems.detail: Compare signal timing, geometry, visibility, and behavior explanations.

title: Reproduce a disputed empirical effect with a broader sample
observed_condition: A published empirical relationship appears sensitive to sample geography and time window, leaving uncertainty about generalizability.
unresolved_core: Determine whether the reported effect survives a preregistered broader-sample replication with harmonized measurement and robustness checks.
knowledge_frontier: Effect direction is reported; external validity remains unresolved.
success: A reproducible analysis that predefines the sample, estimand, robustness family, and criteria for support/attenuation/reversal.
authority: No consequential intervention; publication claims remain subject to scholarly review.

subproblems.title: Freeze replication protocol
subproblems.detail: Specify estimand, sample, exclusions, and robustness checks before outcomes are inspected.

subproblems.title: Build harmonized panel
subproblems.detail: Map source definitions and preserve transformation provenance.

subproblems.title: Run independent reproduction
subproblems.detail: Execute from a clean environment and compare outputs.
